summary:
I found one blocking defect where the lanes meet. A production save loses a weekly-list point. Production (f2c93f1) still deals the task "선물 상자에서 하나 내밀기" (id 'gift'), and 66c8110 removed it. When deploy-2's weekState repairs that week, it replaces the 'gift' slot with a new task at n=0. The point the player already earned is dropped: OW-1 keeps that point for the removed 'days' task (w.kept), but nothing keeps it for 'gift'. I ran it with a production record that has 'gift' done plus four other tasks done. Production shows 5/5 and the claim button. Deploy-2 shows 4/5 and no button, and on the next Monday it pays no weekly gift. This breaks hard line 10, so it is a 'must'.

I also confirmed two smaller defects by running them:
- **should:** The new importSeen guard on the storage listener makes a tab ignore another tab's full reset when the clock went back after an import. The tab's next save then writes the old record over the reset, so the reset is undone.
- **nit:** The salon normalize change (the colour now comes from the last colors line sorted by `at`) can undo the octopus's latest dye on reload, but only if that dye was asked after the clock went back.

Read only or minor (nits):
- importJSON writes the record to storage once before its own checks end and before lastSeen is clipped. A second tab gets that write with lastSeen 3 days ahead; the clipped write follows at once, and I saw no lasting harm.
- The text "지난주 선물" is used even when the week paid at the change was several weeks ago.
- The storage listener now parses every save's JSON twice.

The rest held under my probes and reading:
- The intro's new CSS variables are fully removed after the intro.
- `kept` cannot be counted twice.
- A tab still on the old build, open across the week change, does not lose the weekly gift in either order.
- The loft and rest code never leaves the octopus asleep upstairs.

npm test passes: all 12 files, exit 0. The font check says `stale: none`.

Known and excluded: the octopus being moved to the attic blanket when a turn ends while it is upstairs (OW-3). The same thing happens when another tab ends the turn (syncRest -> restDown). The owner3 lane should cover both paths.

Probe scripts are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/779b4de3-ceb6-5233-b661-33f83b7682a5/scratchpad/final/v2-code/probes/ and notes are in /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/779b4de3-ceb6-5233-b661-33f83b7682a5/scratchpad/final/v2-code/notes.md.

findings.title: A production save loses a done weekly 'gift' task: 5/5 becomes 4/5 and the weekly gift is never paid
findings.where: js/app.js:4368 oldDone, 4372-4386 weekState (same-week repair and the `due` at the week change); QUESTS at js/app.js:4359 no longer has 'gift'
findings.what: Production f2c93f1 deals and counts '선물 상자에서 하나 내밀기' (QUESTS 'gift', questMark('gift') at prod app.js:3249). Deploy-2 removed the task (66c8110). weekState then treats the slot as unknown and replaces it with a new task at n=0. Only 'days' slots are kept through oldDone/w.kept (OW-1), so a done 'gift' slot's point is lost. Players who were at 5/5 lose the claim button, and at the week change `due` misses the gift (12 shells + 2 seeds). Expected: like 'days', a removed task that was already done still counts once.
findings.evidence:
probes/p1-gift-slot.js, a seeded production record with week 2026-11-09 q = ask 2, look 1, run 1, furn 1, gift 1, harvest 0, diary 0:
prod 11-12: note (5/5), claim true
new  11-12: note (4/5), claim false, q ask:2 look:1 run:1 furn:1 water:0 harvest:0 diary:0
new  11-16 (next Monday): prev null, shells 23 (20 + day gift 3 only), no weekly gift
smoke Q section 13 (tools/smoke.js:5061-5066) seeds exactly this week but only asserts that the gift slot is replaced, not that its point is kept.
findings.repro: cd /tmp/claude-0/-home-user/779b4de3-ceb6-5233-b661-33f83b7682a5/scratchpad/final/v2-code/probes && NODE_PATH=$(npm root -g) node p1-gift-slot.js (expects copies of 6d03faf and f2c93f1 in /dev/shm/v2code/{new,prod}; see lib.js)
findings.suggested_fix: Generalise oldDone into a table of removed tasks: 'days' as now (three days in that week), and 'gift' done when (x.n|0) >= 1. Count both into w.kept on repair and into `due` at the week change. Make the #week-kept line generic (for example '목록에서 빠진 일도 이번 주엔 한 걸로 셌어.'). Extend smoke Q section 13 so 'gift:1' plus four done gives 5/5 and the claim button, and so the next Monday pays it.

findings.title: importSeen guard drops a later reset (or import) from another tab after the clock goes back; this tab then writes the old record over it
findings.what: After an import, the tab ignores every storage write whose lastSeen is below the import time. A full reset in another tab writes lastSeen = Date.now() (S = defaults()). If the device clock went back after the import, that value is smaller, so this tab silently ignores the reset. Its next ordinary save then writes the imported record back to storage, and the resetting tab adopts it, so the reset is undone. Production (no guard) follows the reset. The same applies to an import done in the other tab after the clock change.
findings.evidence:
probes/p2-import-guard.js (tab B's Date.now() is 1 h behind):
prod: storedRightAfterReset null, tabA_nameAfterReset null, storedAfterAsave null, tabB_nameNow null
new:  storedRightAfterReset null, tabA_nameAfterReset '불러온문어', storedAfterAsave '불러온문어', tabB_nameNow '불러온문어'
findings.suggested_fix: Narrow the guard to the case it was written for, a late last write from a tab closed just before the import. Let it expire a few seconds after the import (clear importSeen). Never drop a record with a different octopus.born or no octopus.name (a reset), nor one written by an import. Add a smoke X step with a clock offset in the second tab.

findings.title: Salon normalize can undo the octopus's latest dye on reload when that ask was made after the clock went back
findings.where: js/salon.js:656 (normalize step 2: colour = last colors line by `at`)
findings.what: The W3 change makes the last colors line (sorted by `at`) decide the colour even when octopus.color is valid. A dye asked after the device clock went back gets an `at` earlier than the previous line. In play the colour is that answer, but after a reload deploy-2 shows the previous colour. Production keeps the answered colour. This silently changes the octopus's chosen colour in the saved record.
findings.evidence:
probes/p3-salon-color-order.js (node, both builds' js/salon.js):
prod colour after load: #4fa868 (in play it was #4fa868)
new colour after load: #4a86d8 (in play it was #4fa868)
findings.suggested_fix: Keep octopus.color when it is valid and equals the colour of some colors line (or of the line whose ask is the latest done ask). Fall back to the last line only when octopus.color matches no line, which is the hand-edited case W3 was about.

findings.title: importJSON writes the record to storage before its checks finish and before lastSeen is clipped
findings.where: js/app.js:3725 (renderAll inside the try) -> renderAll js/app.js:2988 -> renderBagChip -> weekState save()
findings.what: renderAll now calls renderBagChip, and weekState saves when the imported week is another week. So the file reaches localStorage (and other tabs, as a storage event) inside the 'draw first, save only if it works' block, still carrying the file's lastSeen. If anything later in renderAll threw, the catch would restore memory but not storage. The clipped save follows at once, and in my run the second tab ended clipped and a later reset survived its reload.
findings.evidence: probes/p4-import-early-save.js: during one import tab A writes twice: {seenAheadMs: 259199339, week 2026-11-09} then {seenAheadMs: 1}; tab B's listener saw the first (+3 days) event. probes/p5-import-future-chain.js: B's lastSeen ends at now, and after a reset in A, B's reload stays reset (no lasting harm seen).
findings.suggested_fix: Clip S.settings.lastSeen right after normalize inside importJSON, and suppress saves during the trial render (for example a flag that makes save() a no-op until the import is accepted).

findings.title: '지난주 선물' line is used even when the week that was paid was several weeks ago
findings.what: At the week change, weekState pays any unclaimed 5/5 from the stored week, however old it is. A player back after three weeks is told '지난주 선물은 살림에 넣어 뒀어', which is not true for last week.
findings.evidence: Read only: `due` (js/app.js:4382) does not look at how far w.key is from the current week; both texts are fixed strings.
findings.repro: Seed week.key three Mondays back with 5/5 unclaimed, open on a later Monday.
findings.suggested_fix: Say '그 주 선물' or '지난번 주 선물' when w.prev comes from a week other than the one just before.

findings.title: The storage listener parses each saved record's JSON twice
findings.where: js/app.js:4243 (parseState in the guard), then adoptRemote js/app.js:2067 parses again
findings.what: Every storage event now runs a full JSON.parse just to read lastSeen, even when no import happened (importSeen 0), and adoptRemote then parses the same string again. Saves with many trips are large.
findings.suggested_fix: Skip the parse when importSeen is 0, or pass the parsed object on to takeRemote/adoptRemote.

checked_ok: npm test on a copy of 6d03faf: all 12 files pass, exit 0 (world OK; brain 517, model-voice 26, runner 568, api 225, cook 192, salon 234, cook-stickers 177, play-stickers 180, poster-art 287, art-extra 93, export 46). Font check: stale: none.

Tests diff: the only removed check is intro-shots' 'the passing cloud covers the full width' (midRow share === 1). That removal is right: owner decision 6b makes the bank thin, and sky-band visibility checks replace it. test-salon's changed expectation (salon line by 'demo-rules' -> 'unknown' when ask 'a1' is not in the record) matches the new W4 rule. smoke.js lost no checks (tabOf refactor, new scenarios Q, Z, X added).

w.kept cannot be set twice: a repair only counts 'days' slots, and every state that still has a 'days' slot predates the repair, so it has no kept (reasoned through: reload, two new tabs, a production tab writing back).

Old-build tab open across the week change next to a deploy-2 tab, 5/5 unclaimed: the weekly gift is put in once, whichever tab acts first (probes/p7-old-tab-weekchange.js: shells 35, prev {12, 2} in both orders).
Day gift: the minute timer and visibility path pay once per day (giftDay check). The giftTell line is dropped on a later day; weekTell defers under the intro, a hidden tab or a showing toast (read).
'ask' count: questMark('ask') now runs only after plan succeeds and not when this tab's octopus was asleep (woke). The awake window still counts (read; Q22 covers it).

Loft/rest truth table (read): rest only starts after restDown (finalPose, syncRest). octMountLoft refuses while restPhase is 'awake' or the scene state is sleep. lieDown's place/jumpTo can therefore not run while the octopus is upstairs. moveTo upstairs resolves without moving, and octUnmountLoft hands the scene's anchor back to the app.

Intro (probes/p6-intro-setsky.js, SwiftShader, clear and rain): html style rewritten 9 times during the sky phase, 7 with --intro-grad and 8 box-shadow layers. After finish there is no style attribute and none of the intro classes; --intro-sky, --intro-grad and --intro-shade are removed. 2D fallback: skyCut is missing, so the variables are removed once and setSky then returns early.
setGarden plotKey and setPlayerDye early returns: the key is the colour hex plus water after clamping, and vertex colours are not palette-dependent, so no real change compares equal (read).
Garden: plotView clamps water to 0..2, unknown colours draw grey and harvest without a name, colour-less entries become empty (read; smoke X covers it).

Per-frame and per-minute cost list: app dailyGift every 60 s while visible (cheap unless it pays). weekTell 1 s polling only while a line is pending. MutationObserver on body for 'open' attributes only. storage listener: an extra JSON.parse per event (C6). renderAll on each remote write now also runs weekState, plotLabels, setGarden (key early return) and setPlayerDye (early return). Scene: plClearPath per octopus walk upstairs only; pick's exterior raycast per tap only; nothing new per frame after the intro. Intro: per frame during the sky phase, skyCut plus two getBoundingClientRect reads, and a gradient and 8-layer 200vmax box-shadow rewrite whenever the cut moves (only during the bank pass).

Known OW-3 behaviour, excluded: a turn ending while the octopus is upstairs moves it down. The same happens when another tab ends the turn (syncRest -> restDown, smoke Z 5-5 asserts it). Lane owner3 should change both paths together.
Intro cost on a real phone at 60 fps: under SwiftShader I measured only about 29 frames for the whole sky phase.
The intro on resize, skip and reduced motion beyond reading finish() and skyCut; the cloud-lane check covered those.
The repo's slow suites (smoke, test-scene-perf, intro-shots): left to the lead, as the brief asks.
Salon, cook and audio behaviour outside the cross-lane points named in the brief.
